about: PR 60's guard-removal proofs, run by bin/check-sensitivity --ledger (Check's own step beside Q's): each mutation removes one part of a review fix (#8's installer kept-page guard, then the six suggestion, reach-map and browser-note fixes, then the service's reach caller in service/reach.ts, then the resume nudge and the live switch's folder check and cached defaults), or a control it must keep, and the named regression must fail by an assertion; with the source restored it must pass. Not part of Q's reconciliation ledger, which describes its candidate only.
